label: run136 measured 2023 load
definition: Step 1 of the ORDC tail re-fit: run134's exact recipe re-solved now that the MEASURED 2023 load-resource RRS-UFR series is built (scripts/build_ercot_as_2023.py, ~884 MW), so the co-opt load-resource credit (ercot_load_resource_reserve) is active for 2023 for the first time (storage-AS still scoped from 2025). 2024/2025 reproduce run134 exactly (33.8/38.0, parity check), confirming the only change is the 2023 credit. Finding: crediting measured 2023 reserves COOLS 2023 49.8->43.1 avg (tail 171/94->129/73) — UNDER actual 48.4 (181/104) — because the co-opt model reaches 2023's real out-of-market (RTORDPA/ECRS-conservatism) tail only through the reserve over-fire the credit removes. Confirms with measured (not estimated) 2023 data the documented rationale for scoping the reserve credits off in 2023.
